page.overview:
Who is Dark Dragon Ball Enhancement?

The user maintains their standard appearance; however, they gain a dark crimson and black flame-like aura that resembles the Evil Aura.

Thanks to the Warrior in Black's wish to Dark Shenron, all of the Warriors in Black achieved this form.

With the power-ups, the Future Warrior in Black utilized this state against Xeno Trunks' Super Saiyan God form and later on applied Super Saiyan with the state to compete with Xeno Trunks during their second and proper bout. Later on, the Warrior in Black applies the Super Saiyan 3 transformation with this state to battle against Jiren and Ultra Instinct Sign Goku.

Thanks to being Saiyans, the Future Warrior in Black and Warrior in Black are capable of using their Super Saiyan transformations alongside their Dark Dragon Ball Enhancement for a further enhancement to their power.
